questions.label: Is this an organization-managed business account or deployment?
questions.help: Confirm the actual account and plan. A personal account is not a managed business workspace.

questions.label: Will it process confidential, personal or regulated information?
questions.help: Consider prompts, uploads, source code, meetings and content reachable through integrations—not only what policy permits.

questions.label: Is it connected to organizational content, APIs, plugins or integrations?
questions.help: Include read-only workspace retrieval. Access to content is different from permission to change it.

questions.label: Can it change production systems, permissions or sensitive business records?
questions.help: Include enabled actions, tools, flows and write-capable credentials.

questions.label: Can it take actions without individual human approval?
questions.help: Check agent mode, triggers and confirmation settings for the actual deployment.

questions.label: Are outputs customer-facing, externally published or used in operational workflows?
questions.help: Include code or summaries incorporated into business operations, even when they receive human review. Purely exploratory drafts can be treated differently.

questions.label: Does it support consequential decisions about employment, individuals, finances, legal matters or health?
questions.help: Answer for the documented use case, not hypothetical capabilities of the product.

questions.label: Could incorrect output materially affect people, security, finances or operations?
questions.help: Assess plausible consequences and reliance. Human review reduces exposure but does not eliminate it.

questions.label: Is meaningful human validation required before important output is relied upon?
questions.help: This should be a defined operating practice, not an assumption based on having an enterprise license.

questions.label: Have the applicable retention, training, sharing and access settings been reviewed and accepted?
questions.help: Defaults start at No because public documentation cannot confirm this client’s configuration. Change this after the actual review.

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.plan: Business / Enterprise workspace — confirm purchased plan
tools.purpose: Internal drafting, summarization and document analysis, with human review before important output is used.
notes: Profile assumes a managed business workspace and user-provided public/internal material. Connected apps and autonomous actions are outside this bounded starting profile.
Business data protections do not authorize confidential or personal data. Confirm account, retention, training options, enabled apps and actual organizational data policy.

tools.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
tools.plan: Microsoft 365 Copilot in the client tenant — confirm license
tools.purpose: Draft email and documents, summarize meetings and chats, and retrieve workplace information within the user’s existing permissions.
notes: Connected productivity profile. Workspace content can include confidential or personal information; actual exposure depends on existing permissions and content.
Do not infer privileged access or autonomous production changes. Confirm source sharing, labels, agents and tools. Microsoft documentation may use the newer Microsoft Copilot name.

sources.title: Microsoft Copilot data, privacy and security

tools.name: Claude
tools.plan: Team / Enterprise workspace — confirm purchased plan
tools.purpose: Internal drafting, summarization and analysis of approved documents, with human review.
notes: Bounded document-assistant profile with no connected apps or autonomous actions selected. Uploaded content remains within the organization’s approved boundary.
Enabled connectors can retrieve information and take actions; shared credentials can extend reach. Confirm the actual plan, connector scope and retention/training settings.

sources.title: Claude model training and commercial data

tools.name: Google Gemini
tools.plan: Gemini in a qualifying Google Workspace edition
tools.purpose: Draft and summarize Gmail and Docs, research permitted Drive content, and assist with Sheets and presentations under human review.
notes: Workspace-integrated profile. Relevant content follows source permissions; potential data exposure is not a grant of organizational permission.
Confirm qualifying edition, work-account use, feature availability, source sharing and connected apps. Consumer or additional-service use can have different protections.

sources.title: Google Workspace generative AI privacy hub

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.purpose: Assist developers with code suggestions, explanations, tests and documentation. Human review and testing are required before merge or deployment.
notes: Coding-assistant profile. Prompt context can include current/open files and repository content. Permitted source code means approved repositories under the company’s policy.
Secrets, credentials and production/customer datasets are excluded from the starting permitted-data selection. Agent mode, CLI, MCP and command execution need separate review.
The starting code-generation use can materially affect software security if output is incorrect. Human review and tests reduce exposure; they do not make that consequence impossible.

sources.title: GitHub Copilot context and prompt engineering

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.plan: Copilot Studio — authenticated internal knowledge agent
tools.purpose: Answer employee questions from approved read-only knowledge sources. No customer-facing channel, production writes or autonomous action is included in this starting profile.
notes: This is a bounded example of an agent-building platform, not a default for every Copilot Studio agent. Confirm actual knowledge sources, tools, channels and triggers.
Maker versus end-user credentials and DLP policies can change reach. Review action permissions and human confirmation before enabling write-capable behavior.

tools.name: Perplexity
tools.purpose: Research public sources and produce cited summaries, with human source checking. Approved internal documents may be added deliberately.
notes: Research-only profile with no internal connectors or computer-use actions selected. Public-source results still require human checking.
Uploads and enterprise file connectors expand exposure. Computer, Comet, connectors and shared spaces require their own scope review; do not assume a personal account has Enterprise protections.

sources.title: Perplexity data collection and account differences

tools.name: Zoom AI Companion
tools.plan: Organization-managed Zoom Workplace with approved AI features
tools.purpose: Prepare internal meeting summaries and action-item drafts. The host reviews accuracy and sharing; sensitive meeting types require explicit authorization.
notes: Meeting-summary profile. Meeting speech-to-text can contain confidential information and participant details; enabled features can also use chat or screen content.
Review feature enablement, meeting notice, transcript retention and summary recipients. Summary distribution is a use of output even when the meeting itself is internal.

sources.title: How Zoom AI features handle data

tools.name: Salesforce Agentforce
tools.plan: Agentforce Employee agent — read-only internal knowledge profile
tools.purpose: Help employees find approved knowledge and CRM information within their authorized scope. Human review is required; customer-facing service and write actions are outside this starting profile.
notes: Explicit read-only Employee-agent scenario. Confirm actual accessible objects, fields and records; permitted data does not automatically include every CRM category.
Employee and Service agents can run in different security contexts. Confirm agent type, credentials, sharing and enabled actions before approving broader use.

tools.name: Grammarly
tools.plan: Enterprise — approved business apps and domains
tools.purpose: Improve writing, tone and clarity in approved business applications. Users review text before sending or publishing it.
notes: Writing-assistant profile. Text in enabled apps and generative prompts can include confidential information; approved data classes remain an organization decision.
Review app/domain restrictions, generative features and DLP controls. Newer document-agent capabilities are separately configurable and are not assumed by this preset.

methodology.title: Illustrative use-based risk proposal
methodology.note: This mockup uses transparent internal proposal rules. Vendor documentation describes capabilities; it does not validate client configuration or prescribe these scores. Annual review is the selected product default, not a NIST-mandated period.
